el: Greek, informal 'εσύ', Greek wine-trade usage; Greek PDO names in Greek with the Latin form where useful
ja: Japanese, です/ます style, natural Japanese wine-education wording (ワイン検定 terms, カタカナ grape names as used in Japan)
ko: Korean, 해요체, Korean wine-education wording, grape names as used in Korea
zh-hant: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan/Hong Kong usage), natural wine-education wording, grape names as used in Taiwan
pt: European Portuguese (Portugal), 'tu' register, Portuguese wine-trade usage
tr: Turkish, informal 'sen', Turkish wine-trade usage (WSET Seviye 1/2/3)
th: Thai, polite neutral register with no gendered particles (no ครับ/ค่ะ), Thai wine-education wording
pl: Polish, informal 'ty', neutral (avoid gendered verb forms addressed to the reader, use impersonal/plural)
ru: Russian, informal 'ты' or neutral impersonal constructions avoiding gendered past tense addressed to the reader
zh-hans: Simplified Chinese (mainland usage), natural wine-education wording, grape names as used in mainland China
ar: Modern Standard Arabic, neutral wording (avoid gendered second-person forms where possible), grape and region names in Arabic with Latin form where useful
sv: Swedish (Sweden), informal 'du', Swedish wine-trade usage (Systembolaget-style vocabulary: mousserande vin, starkvin, druvsort, fatlagring); level naming 'WSET nivå 1/2/3', qualification names in English (WSET Level 2 Award in Wines)
da: Danish, informal 'du', Danish wine-trade usage (mousserende vin, hedvin, druesort, fadlagring); level naming 'WSET niveau 1/2/3', qualification names in English
no: Norwegian Bokmål (folder /no/, lang nb), informal 'du', Norwegian wine-trade usage (Vinmonopolet-style vocabulary: musserende vin, sterkvin, druesort, fatlagring); level naming 'WSET nivå 1/2/3', qualification names in English
fi: Finnish, informal 'sinä' (sinuttelu, as in learning apps), Finnish wine-trade usage (Alko-style vocabulary: kuohuviini, väkevöity viini, rypälelajike, tammikypsytys); level naming 'WSET-taso 1/2/3' or 'WSET Level 1/2/3' in titles where that is what people search; mind the case endings after WSET (WSET-tason, WSET-kokeeseen)
ro: Romanian, informal 'tu', neutral: no adjectives or participles agreeing with the reader (not 'pregătit/pregătită': rephrase); Romanian wine-trade usage (soi, vin spumant, vin fortifiat, baric/învechire în baric, DOC/IG); level naming 'WSET Nivelul 1/2/3'; numbers ≥ 20 take 'de' (50 de întrebări)
hu: Hungarian, informal 'te' (tegezés, as in learning apps), Hungarian wine-trade usage (szőlőfajta, pezsgő, likőrbor, hordós érlelés, OEM/OFJ for PDO/PGI only where useful); level naming 'WSET 1. szint / 2. szint / 3. szint' (titles may also use 'WSET Level 2'); Hungarian names for Hungarian wines (Tokaji aszú, furmint, hárslevelű, kékfrankos, Egri Bikavér)
is: Icelandic, informal 'þú', neutral: avoid adjectives agreeing with the reader (not 'tilbúinn/tilbúin': rephrase); Icelandic wine vocabulary (þrúga/þrúgutegund, freyðivín, styrkt vín, eikartunna); grape and appellation names international; level naming 'WSET stig 1/2/3'
cs: Czech, informal 'ty', neutral: no gendered past tense or adjectives addressed to the reader (not 'připravený/připravená', not 'přečetl jsi': rephrase with impersonal or present forms); Czech wine-trade usage (odrůda, šumivé víno, fortifikované/dezertní víno, zrání v sudu); level naming 'WSET úroveň 1/2/3' (titles may also use 'WSET Level 2')
sk: Slovak, informal 'ty', neutral: no gendered past tense or adjectives addressed to the reader (rephrase); Slovak wine-trade usage (odroda, šumivé víno, fortifikované víno, zrenie v sude); level naming 'WSET úroveň 1/2/3'
hr: Croatian, informal 'ti', neutral: no gendered past tense or adjectives addressed to the reader (not 'spreman/spremna', not 'pročitao si': rephrase); Croatian wine-trade usage (sorta, pjenušavo vino, desertno/pojačano vino, dozrijevanje u bačvi); level naming 'WSET razina 1/2/3'
sl: Slovenian, informal 'ti', neutral: no gendered past tense or adjectives addressed to the reader (rephrase); Slovenian wine-trade usage (sorta, peneče vino, ojačano vino, zorenje v sodu); level naming 'WSET stopnja 1/2/3'
